title: I Tested How Passive This AI Side Hustle Really Is
channel: Chris Koerner on The Koerner Office Podcast

idea.name: Paid micro-consulting sold by email to your list
idea.one_liner: Email a segment of your audience offering 5-minute paid consulting via a Stripe-integrated TidyCal booking link, using Claude with the Omnisend MCP to build segments, write and send the campaign, as a foot in the door to upsell higher-ticket coaching
idea.customer: newsletter subscribers and small business owners with questions
idea.revenue_model: per-booking fee ($5 tested; suggests far higher pricing) plus upsells

key_quotes.quote: While we're waiting, I'm going to use another tool called TidyCal, which is just a calendar booking software, and I'm going to create a 5-minute consulting calendar,
But, I can also upsell coaching packages, recurring stuff, higher ticket stuff, AI audits, whatever.
And that's the thing with charging $5 for consulting, you do more harm than good.

claims.quote: So, 1,013 emails sent, almost all of them were delivered, 39% of them were opened.

claims.claim: $80 revenue from one email to ~1,000 people, 16 calls
claims.quote: Ended up with 80 bucks. So, on 1,000 emails sent, not bad.
Now, that doesn't sound like but that's a dollar a minute, aka $60 an hour, and at a 40-hour work week, quote unquote, that's about $120,000 a year of pure profit,

acquisition_channels.details: randomised ~1,000-contact segment, plain-text email, subject '$5'; follow-ups recommended

ideas.delivery: Live 5-minute calls booked via TidyCal on limited weekday afternoons, or email replies
ideas.other_uk_rules: PECR consent needed for marketing emails to individuals; list must be opted-in

idea.name: Children's market (vendor fair) hosting
idea.one_liner: Host a children's market recruiting vendors by email, with repeated follow-ups driving more sign-ups

key_quotes.quote: She sent another email, and she got four more sign-ups for the kids market.

ideas.other_uk_rules: Venue licensing, public liability insurance, council market/street trading rules
